items.textEn: A literary sketch by Kehat Klezmer [?], from the series "Miniatures." A cloudy winter's day; the sky is grey, the air damp and cold. Wrapped up against the cold, a frozen little Jew stands in the market. Old, small of stature, with a hungry look he stretches out a hand to the passersby — spare a groschen... but he stands silent and mute. People rush past him; no one gives him a groschen, not even a glance... And he, out of great sorrow, still looks at them kindly, as if with love.
